title: VoiceInboxDeadLetterRecord
description: Append-only, structured, transcript-free diagnostic record written when a capture exhausts retries or fails terminally (see 'Add layered error handling' in local-voice-inbox-mvp-implementation-plan.md). By construction this schema has no field for transcript, first-pass note, prompt content, or any other capture content -- only identifiers, timestamps, error classification, and remediation metadata. Consumers (including a future Gmail alert and a future AI issue-reviewer) must be able to read this record without ever seeing capture content.

dead_letter_id.description: Unique identifier for this dead-letter entry.

source_id.description: Superwhisper recording identifier of the capture that failed (matches meta.source_id). Contains no content, only an identifier.

first_seen_at.description: Timestamp of the first processing attempt for this source.

last_attempt_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent processing attempt for this source.

error_class.description: Final failure classification, per the plan's error-handling taxonomy.

error_message.description: Sanitized error message/summary. Must not contain transcript, prompt, or credential content -- enforced by process/review convention, not by this schema.

request_id.description: Upstream (e.g. OpenAI) request ID associated with the failing attempt, if one exists; null for failures with no upstream request (e.g. local disk-write failure).

attempt_history.description: Ordered log of processing attempts for this source, oldest first.

error_class.description: Failure classification for this specific attempt, or null if the attempt succeeded.

error_message.description: Sanitized error message for this specific attempt, or null if the attempt succeeded.

remediation_hint.description: Short, human-actionable suggestion for resolving this dead-letter entry (e.g. 'check OpenAI API key configuration').
